items.title: Corpay (CPAY) Stock Gets Fair Value Boost After Q2 Guidance And Analyst Target Increases
items.summary: Corpay’s updated fair value estimate has shifted from US$395.14 to US$438.50, an adjustment of about 11% in the latest valuation model. This move aligns with recent Street research that clusters price targets in the low to mid US$400s after Q2 results, raised 2026 guidance, and management meetings earlier in the year.
